sources.entry: Supysonic - Python implementation of the Subsonic server API. AGPL-3.0 Python/deb

summary.one_liner: Supysonic is a Python implementation of the Subsonic server API for streaming your music library to Subsonic-compatible clients.
summary.what_it_does: Supysonic implements the Subsonic server API in Python, targeting Subsonic API version 1.12.0. It supports browsing the library by folders or tags, streaming many audio formats, and transcoding. It also offers user and random playlists, cover art, starred tracks and albums with ratings, and internet radio stations. Scrobbling is available for Last.fm and ListenBrainz, and it includes a jukebox mode and chat. Setup uses a supysonic-cli tool to create users and library folders, scan them, and run supysonic-server, with Gunicorn suggested for production serving.
use_cases: stream my music library to a phone app
scrobble plays to Last.fm or ListenBrainz
share a music library with family or friends
run a jukebox or internet radio from my collection
notable: Implements the Subsonic API, so existing Subsonic-compatible clients can connect
Optional daemon watches for library changes and enables jukebox mode
Supports both Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling
Test suite can run against SQLite, MySQL or PostgreSQL
caveats: Targets Subsonic API version 1.12.0 only; the README points to a separate page for implementation status
Default quickstart stores the database in a temporary directory; full setup requires the documentation
Optional daemon is needed for some features such as jukebox mode
